POST start_profile with truthy start_step1 -> configure/ACK; clamp to nextforward; num_steps8, activitiesCPU/GPU (nativeNPU alias), with_stackFalse/record_shapesFalse, mergeFalse. native_capture.sglang_partial_configuration_failure: Not yet a concrete recovery implementation. Failed partial configure can leave pending start target because stop_profile returns failure when notinprogress. Must implement bounded cancel/cleanup protocol before dispatch; do not assume stop always cancels pending state.
native_capture.export: Owned run/profile directories, source/capture SHA, CPU/NPU spans and native SDMA/cache events; raw trace kept node-side, compact typed summaries only in Git

baseline_observations.scope: Includes queue/cache/preparation/compute, not pure prefill kernels. MC native individual call max115.47ms C16/747.04ms C32 does not prove either total critical-path share or bandwidth.

decision_rules.ACCEPTED: Actual CPU/NPU trace execution, all relevant P/D rank coverage, source identity and count/cache/lifecycle correct; intervals discriminate at least one competing mechanism. This only accepts diagnostic information, not service optimization.
decision_rules.INCONCLUSIVE: Trace gap, pending worker profiler, barrier/stop failure, insufficient rank coverage, or no discriminating spans; preserve errors and restore owned profiler state.
decision_rules.optimization_next: Freeze exactly one supported mechanism after trace evidence, compare same frozen contract unprofiled, preserve TPOT/correctness/failure rates and use paired repeat if gain near noise.

headroom_model.reason: No measured reachable kernel/communication bandwidth or trace critical path yet; no invented Roofline bound
